exercices.enonce:
🟢 Niveau Facile

Complète avec la forme correcte du verbe entre parenthèses (base + ing) :
1. I enjoy (read) ________ books.
2. She likes (dance) ________ at parties.
exercices.solution:
1. reading
2. dancing

exercices.enonce:
🟡 Niveau Moyen

Transforme ces phrases en utilisant 'would rather' pour exprimer une préférence :
1. I prefer tea to coffee. → I would rather ________.
2. She prefers staying home to going out. → She would rather ________.
exercices.solution:
1. I would rather have tea than coffee.
2. She would rather stay home than go out.

exercices.enonce:
🟠 Niveau Difficile

Réponds aux questions personnelles suivantes par des phrases complètes, en utilisant 'going to' pour parler de projets futurs :
1. What are you going to do this weekend?
2. Where are you going to go on your next vacation?
exercices.solution:
Exemple de réponses (réponses personnelles acceptées si la structure 'going to' est correcte) :
1. I am going to visit my grandmother this weekend.
2. I am going to go to Nosy Be on my next vacation.

exercices.enonce:
🔴 Niveau Expert (BEPC)

Rédige un court dialogue (4 à 6 répliques) entre deux amis qui discutent de leurs préférences alimentaires (food preferences) avant d'aller au restaurant, en utilisant : une expression de préférence (like/prefer/would rather), un verbe + gerund, et le mot de liaison 'because'.
exercices.solution:
Exemple de réponse :
A: What would you like to eat tonight?
B: I would rather eat pizza than rice, because I love cheese.
A: Really? I prefer eating rice because it's healthier.
B: That's true, but pizza tastes so good! Let's go to the Italian restaurant.
A: Okay, I enjoy trying new restaurants anyway.

exercices.enonce:
🟢 Niveau Facile

Mets les phrases suivantes à l'impératif négatif :
1. (talk) ________ during the test.
2. (be) ________ late tomorrow.
exercices.solution:
1. Don't talk during the test.
2. Don't be late tomorrow.

exercices.enonce:
🟡 Niveau Moyen

Mets ces ordres au discours rapporté en utilisant 'tell' :
1. "Close the door," the teacher said to Rina.
2. "Don't run in the corridor," the teacher said to the boys.
exercices.solution:
1. The teacher told Rina to close the door.
2. The teacher told the boys not to run in the corridor.

exercices.enonce:
🟠 Niveau Difficile

Mets ces requêtes polies au discours rapporté en utilisant 'ask' :
1. "Please help me with this exercise," Nancy said to Tom.
2. "Please don't touch my book," Lova said to her brother.
exercices.solution:
1. Nancy asked Tom to help her with that exercise.
2. Lova asked her brother not to touch her book.

exercices.enonce:
🔴 Niveau Expert (BEPC)

Rapporte cette citation au discours rapporté en utilisant un verbe introducteur approprié (tell/encourage/advise) :
"Believe in yourself and never give up." (Anonymous)

Puis explique en une phrase, en anglais, ce que signifie cette citation.
exercices.solution:
Reported speech : He/She told people to believe in themselves and never to give up.

Meaning : This quote means that people should trust their own abilities and keep trying, even when things are difficult.

exercices.enonce:
🟢 Niveau Facile

Transforme ces phrases exclamatives en utilisant 'What a/an...!' ou 'How...!' :
1. This book is amazing.
2. It was a wonderful trip.
exercices.solution:
1. How amazing this book is!
2. What a wonderful trip it was!

exercices.enonce:
🟡 Niveau Moyen

Complète avec 'used to' ou 'would' selon le cas (parfois les deux sont possibles) :
1. When I was young, I ________ (be) very shy.
2. Every summer, my grandmother ________ (tell) us stories by the fire.
exercices.solution:
1. used to be (état → 'would' impossible)
2. would tell / used to tell

exercices.enonce:
🟠 Niveau Difficile

Réponds à chaque phrase en exprimant ton accord avec 'So' ou 'Neither' + auxiliaire + sujet :
1. I love traveling.
2. He doesn't like horror movies.
3. We have never been to Europe.
exercices.solution:
1. So do I.
2. Neither do I.
3. Neither have we/I.

exercices.enonce:
🔴 Niveau Expert (BEPC)

Relie chaque paire de phrases avec le mot de liaison de contraste indiqué, en faisant attention à la construction grammaticale :
1. It was raining. We went out. (although)
2. The exam was difficult. She passed it. (despite)
3. Tom loves sports. His sister prefers reading. (whereas)
exercices.solution:
1. Although it was raining, we went out.
2. Despite the difficulty of the exam, she passed it. (ou : Despite being difficult, the exam was passed by her.)
3. Tom loves sports, whereas his sister prefers reading.

exercices.enonce:
🟢 Niveau Facile

Classe ces aliments en deux colonnes : Healthy food / Junk food.
Aliments : banana, chips, grilled fish, soda, carrots, candy bar.
exercices.solution:
Healthy food : banana, grilled fish, carrots
Junk food : chips, soda, candy bar

exercices.enonce:
🟡 Niveau Moyen

Donne un conseil avec 'should' ou 'shouldn't' pour chaque situation :
1. Hery drinks soda every day.
2. Lala never eats breakfast.
exercices.solution:
1. Hery shouldn't drink soda every day.
2. Lala should eat breakfast every morning.

exercices.enonce:
🟠 Niveau Difficile

Mets l'adjectif entre parenthèses au comparatif ou au superlatif :
1. An apple is (healthy) ________ than a candy bar.
2. This is the (delicious) ________ meal I have ever eaten.
3. Water is (good) ________ than soda for your health.
exercices.solution:
1. healthier
2. most delicious
3. better

exercices.enonce:
🔴 Niveau Expert (BEPC)

Rédige 3 phrases décrivant tes habitudes alimentaires, en utilisant : un adverbe de fréquence, une structure 'should/shouldn't', et un mot de liaison (but/so/however/therefore).
exercices.solution:
Exemple de réponse :
1. I usually eat vegetables with my meals.
2. I should drink more water every day.
3. I love eating fast food, but I know it isn't good for my health, so I try to eat it rarely.

exercices.enonce:
🟢 Niveau Facile

Transforme cette demande informelle en demande plus polie :
Can I use your phone? → ________
exercices.solution: May I use your phone? (ou : Do you mind if I use your phone?)

exercices.enonce:
🟡 Niveau Moyen

Pour chaque demande, écris une réponse qui accorde la permission ET une réponse qui la refuse :
1. Can I watch TV after dinner?
2. May I invite my friends this weekend?
exercices.solution:
1. Accordée : Yes, you can, but not too late. / Refusée : No, you can't, you need to sleep early tonight.
2. Accordée : Yes, you may, as long as the house stays clean. / Refusée : I'm sorry, but you can't, we have guests this weekend.

exercices.enonce:
🟠 Niveau Difficile

Classe chaque situation selon son type de conflit (inevitable / boundary / intense) :
1. A child refuses to eat vegetables at dinner.
2. A teenager comes home two hours later than agreed.
3. A teenager wants to choose a career that his parents disapprove of.
exercices.solution:
1. Inevitable conflict
2. Boundary conflict
3. Intense conflict

exercices.enonce:
🔴 Niveau Expert (BEPC)

Rédige un court dialogue (5-6 répliques) où un adolescent demande à son père la permission d'organiser une fête chez un ami, en utilisant au moins deux expressions différentes pour demander la permission, et une réponse avec condition (ex : 'Yes, you can, as long as...').
exercices.solution:
Exemple de réponse :
Teenager: Dad, would it be possible for me to go to a party at Rakoto's house this Saturday?
Father: Who else will be there?
Teenager: Just some friends from school. Do you mind if I stay until 10 pm?
Father: Yes, you can, as long as you call me when you arrive and when you leave.
Teenager: Thank you, Dad! I promise I will.
Father: Alright, have fun, but be careful.

exercices.enonce:
🟢 Niveau Facile

Complète avec le mot de vocabulaire approprié :
1. I have a terrible ________ (mal de tête) and need to rest.
2. Exercise ________ (est bon pour) your health.
exercices.solution:
1. headache
2. is good for

exercices.enonce:
🟡 Niveau Moyen

Complète les phrases avec le pronom relatif approprié (who / which / whose / that) :
1. The doctor ________ examined me was very professional.
2. The woman ________ son is a nurse works at the hospital.
exercices.solution:
1. who
2. whose

exercices.enonce:
🟠 Niveau Difficile

Mets les verbes entre parenthèses à la forme correcte (if clause type 2) :
1. If I (be) ________ you, I would see a doctor.
2. If they (exercise) ________ regularly, they would be fitter.
3. If he (not smoke) ________, he would be healthier.
exercices.solution:
1. were
2. exercised
3. didn't smoke

exercices.enonce:
🔴 Niveau Expert (BEPC)

Réagis à l'affirmation suivante en exprimant ton accord partiel, puis complète avec une phrase au if clause type 2 :
"Traditional medicine is more effective than modern medicine."
exercices.solution:
Exemple de réponse :
I agree to some extent, but modern medicine is based on scientific proof. If everyone combined both types of medicine, people would be healthier.

exercices.enonce:
🟢 Niveau Facile

Associe chaque métier à sa description :
Métiers : vet / librarian / architect
Descriptions :
a. This person designs buildings.
b. This person takes care of sick animals.
c. This person works in a library.
exercices.solution:
a. architect
b. vet
c. librarian

exercices.enonce:
🟡 Niveau Moyen

Complète avec 'for' ou 'since' :
1. She has been a nurse ________ 2015.
2. He has worked at this company ________ three years.
3. I have known my best friend ________ we were in primary school.
exercices.solution:
1. since
2. for
3. since

exercices.enonce:
🟠 Niveau Difficile

Choisis la forme correcte du verbe (present perfect ou simple past) :
1. She (work) ________ as a journalist for ten years.
2. He (start) ________ his new job last Monday.
3. They (move) ________ to this city in 2019.
exercices.solution:
1. has worked
2. started
3. moved

exercices.enonce:
🔴 Niveau Expert (BEPC)

Rédige une courte lettre de candidature (4-5 phrases) pour postuler au poste de 'nurse' dans un hôpital, en utilisant au moins 3 expressions clés de lettre de candidature (ex : I am writing to apply for..., I have ... years of experience..., I look forward to hearing from you).
exercices.solution:
Exemple de réponse :
Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to apply for the position of nurse advertised at your hospital. I have three years of experience working in a clinic and I am a hard-working and caring person. I would be grateful for the opportunity to discuss my application in an interview.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Yours faithfully,
[Name]

exercices.enonce:
🟢 Niveau Facile

Complète les phrases avec le mot approprié parmi : deforestation / pollution / global warming.
1. ________ is causing temperatures to rise around the world.
2. Cutting down too many trees leads to ________.
exercices.solution:
1. Global warming
2. deforestation

exercices.enonce:
🟡 Niveau Moyen

Complète les phrases avec le verbe entre parenthèses au gérondif (-ing) :
1. She enjoys (recycle) ________ plastic bottles.
2. We should avoid (waste) ________ water.
exercices.solution:
1. recycling
2. wasting

exercices.enonce:
🟠 Niveau Difficile

Mets les verbes entre parenthèses à la forme correcte (if clause type 2) :
1. If people (stop) ________ cutting down trees, there would be less deforestation.
2. If we (reduce) ________ our carbon footprint, the planet would be healthier.
3. If everyone (protect) ________ endangered species, biodiversity would improve.
exercices.solution:
1. stopped
2. reduced
3. protected

exercices.enonce:
🔴 Niveau Expert (BEPC)

En suivant la structure problème / cause / conséquence / solution, rédige un court texte (5-6 phrases) décrivant le problème de la pollution plastique dans les océans, en utilisant au moins une phrase au if clause type 2 et un verbe + gerund.
exercices.solution:
Exemple de réponse :
One of the biggest environmental problems today is plastic pollution in the oceans. This is mainly caused by people throwing away plastic bottles and bags instead of recycling them. As a result, many marine animals die because they mistake plastic for food. If everyone avoided using single-use plastic, the oceans would be much cleaner. We should also suggest organizing beach clean-up days to reduce this pollution.
